A.prompt: Image 1 is an unrelated character sheet: ignore it completely and do not draw any character. Draw a wide, flat, eye-level panorama of a huge futuristic city at night, seen from far away across a flat horizon, a very long telephoto view in which the distant skyscrapers look flat and are stacked and overlapping tightly in many layers behind one another, filling the whole middle band of the image from the left edge to the right edge, from about 15 percent to about 70 percent of the image height. The skyscrapers are full of glowing neon lights in magenta, cyan and amber, with big glowing holographic billboards showing abstract blobs of colour, and rain falls through the scene. Along the top edge of the picture is the blurred dark grey overhanging edge of a near building, and along the bottom edge the blurred dark grey rooftops and street of the near foreground, both plain greyscale with no colour. There is no tower in the picture, no character, no robot and no text. Clean Japanese anime cel shading with thin black line art, flat colors, anime background art. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.
